relTest.notes: Project details templates: in Library → Project details, make your own sections and fields (or start from Residential, Commercial, Litigated and Non-litigated), pick one in Prepare a project, and get a blank Excel, Word or text file to fill in. Import my files now also reads the claim's documents (PDF claim summaries, property appraiser, permit reports, Word files; scanned pages in the Windows and Mac app) and shows what it found, with where it came from, before anything is filled. Point at a field once in a new kind of document and it's found by itself from then on. Fields not marked for the report are kept with the project without printing.
